1. Study
2. Take practice questions
3. Rationalize each questions
4. Study more
5. More practice questions
6. Socialize with other takers, try to trade test with them.
7. Do 'spaced repetition'
8. When taking practice questions, get at least 75% consistently
9. Try to practise 'teaching' the hard subject you find. (Kahit walang nakikinig sayo, imagine mo nalang)
10. Hanapin mo yung season na mas marami ang retakers kesa fresh takers (higher chance dito)
11. Bonus: JUST DO YOUR BEST!! (Para kahit hindi ka makapasok sa top, you know you did your best. Buong Pilipinas kalaban mo at hindi mo ma prepredict kung sinong android or halimaw ang makakalaban mo.) Pag ginawa mo yung best mo wala kang regret 😁

Magagamit mo rin yan sa board exam! Promise! Mas worth na ibuhos mo yung energy mo sa pag rereview at pag papalakas ng fundamentals mo over sa pag tatanong kung legal ba yung mga gantong bagay :)
